pokedexEntries.di: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.

pokedexEntries.prl: It apparently had a huge shell for protection in ancient times. It lives in shallow tidal pools.

pokedexEntries.pt: Long ago, its entire back was shielded with a sturdy shell. There are traces of it left in its cells.

pokedexEntries.hgss: When its natural enemy attacks, it oozes purple fluid and escapes.

pokedexEntries.su: It has strong regenerative capabilities. Even if parts of it are bitten off by fish Pokémon, it will return to normal within a few hours.

pokedexEntries.mo: Plankton, invisible to the naked eye, is its main food source. It comes onto the land periodically, but the reason for this is not known.

pokedexEntries.us: Long ago, it had a shell on its back. There's now a vestigial plate on its back that's hard but thin.

pokedexEntries.um: Their shape and color change, depending on their environment and diet. There are many of them at beaches where the waves are calm.

pokedexEntries.bd: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.

pokedexEntries.shp: It apparently had a huge shell for protection in ancient times. It lives in shallow tidal pools.

pokedexEntries.la: Eats beach sand for nourishment. Should one Gastrodon encounter another of a different color, a fierce battle will inevitably ensue.

pokedexEntries.sc: Its whole body is sticky with mucus. In the past, this form of Gastrodon was by far the more numerous one.

pokedexEntries.vi: It appears on beaches where the waters are shallow. Once it catches prey, it will slowly melt them with its mucus before slurping them up.
